rulings_in_order: Ruling: Keep main and proceed without repeat design permission — user explicitly authorized current branch, subagents and execution; developer says existing authorization persists — costs rework if interpretation differs.

Ruling: Use diagnosis64/calibration32/headroom128 with three natural budgets and a diagnosis support-document oracle — bounded first-two-stage diagnostic before expensive controller labels; all-k competitiveness remains future work — costs reduced ability to rule out a fixed intermediate budget.

Ruling: No index reuse in this experiment; validate actual nested empty reuse plus physical commit — avoids depending on known legacy ancestry bug without modifying frozen files — costs small additional embedding compute and leaves general recursive fix for a separately versioned reuse experiment.

Ruling: Continuous outer service/setup endpoints plus continuous supervisor deadlines are authoritative; old internal timing is labeled active diagnostics — sufficient for actual fixed-policy cost without duplicating reader semantics — no continuous prefill-component claim possible.

Ruling: Retain failed v1 unchanged, repair reviewed runtime and repeat the exact prospectively fixed cohorts in a new versioned root — all304 failed before question generation, so no semantic outcome can select favorable tasks; same sample and method remain binding — costs extra setup/warmup compute and a versioned amendment, and would be invalid if zero-question-call audit were wrong.

Ruling: Fix the constructor accounting defect in separately committed current software, preserve measured v2 at9ddc4ae with its immutable snapshots/manifests, and require that exact source checkout for raw verification — completed sessions never took the failure path, so their results remain valid without rebinding source — costs a less convenient source-pinned reproduction path and would require invalidating the run if the supposedly unobserved failure path had occurred.
